## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in London, United Kingdom. The listing gives its length as 1 hours, over a route of about 3.0 km. It starts at Cutty Sark, King William Walk, London SE10 9HT, UK. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Cutty Sark. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Unlock the past and embark on a journey through maritime history with our In-App Audio Tour, starting at the iconic Cutty Sark, where your ticket is already included.
> The tour kicks off at the Cutty Sark, the famous tea clipper that's now a fascinating museum. Please note that an audio tour inside the Cutty Sark is not provided within this bundle – it is available at the museum as a separate guide.
> After your visit to the Cutty Sark, begin your exploration in Greenwich, an area closely connected with Britain’s maritime past. It includes stops at bustling Greenwich Market, the National Maritime Museum with its playful exhibits, and the star-gazing Royal Observatory. From past to present, the route connects these historical gems in a seamless thread, ending with the grandeur of the Old Royal Naval College. Along the way, step onto the Prime Meridian at Greenwich Park, where East meets West, and get up close with the artistry of Queen's House and the Painted Hall. Each stop offers a unique glimpse into the area's rich heritage.
